name: Custom Apron
description:
FEATURES

Best Material: Canvas Fabric.
 

  • The Custom Apron is the perfect blend of style, functionality, and comfort for all your cooking or crafting endeavors. Crafted with high-quality materials and attention to detail, this apron is fully customizable to suit your unique preferences.
  • Fabric: 100% Polyester Canvas
  • GSM: Approximately 140g/m2
  • Designed with an adjustable buckle, this apron ensures a perfect fit for all body types. Whether you're tall, short, slim, or curvy, the adjustable buckle allows you to customize the apron's size and length to your liking, providing maximum comfort and flexibility while you work.
  • Made from durable and easy-to-clean fabric, this apron offers protection from spills, stains, and splatters, keeping your clothes clean and pristine even during the messiest of tasks. The customizable design allows you to add your name, logo, or favorite design, making it a stylish and personalized accessory for any kitchen or workspace.
  • Ideal for home cooks, professional chefs, artists, or craftsmen, the Custom Apron is a versatile and practical addition to any wardrobe. Whether you're cooking up a storm in the kitchen, working on DIY projects, or serving customers in a restaurant, this apron ensures you look and feel your best while staying clean and organized.
     

Customization: The design will be printed on one side
 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Apron

 

NOTE:
 

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products.

Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc.

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

You’ve now used a Printway template to create the artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

Fill out the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents the “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
